capabilities: download files from HTTP/HTTPS URLs into the vault
detect file types and add appropriate extensions
extract or customize filenames from URLs
select a destination folder with type-ahead support
block dangerous file types and enforce size limits
extras: README states the plugin is not yet in the Obsidian Community Plugins directory and must be installed manually; CORS proxy support is mentioned in the manifest description but not detailed in the README.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to download a file from a URL into the vault, forcing users to save files externally and import them manually.
summary: URL downloader that fetches files from HTTP/HTTPS links directly into the vault, with filename detection, folder selection and CORS proxy support.
